description: Job description Experience: 0-1 years of experience Location: Noida (Work from Office) Role Overview We are looking for an enthusiastic Android Developer to join our engineering team. You will work on developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining SDKs that enable mobile applications to seamlessly integrate our products and services. This role is ideal for a fresh graduate or early-career developer looking to build strong foundations in mobile application development, SDK development, APIs, and debugging. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and enhance Android(primary)/iOS SDKs and related integration components. Support integration of SDKs into mobile applications and troubleshoot integration issues. Work with APIs, libraries, documentation, and developer tools to build reliable SDK solutions. Debug and resolve SDK-related issues across different devices, OS versions, and application environments. Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code. Conduct unit testing, integration testing, and regression testing for SDK releases. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and QA teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, integration guides, and release notes. Monitor SDK performance and identify opportunities for optimization. Stay updated with Android/iOS development practices, mobile technologies, and industry standards. Qualifications 01 year of experience in software development, mobile development, or SDK development. Strong programming fundamentals and understanding of OOP, data structures, and APIs. Good knowledge of Java/Kotlin for Android or Swift/Objective-C for iOS. Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and mobile application architecture. Familiarity with Git/version control. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Good communication and documentation skills. Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced product environment. Good to have Exposure to SDK integration or third-party libraries. Familiarity with Gradle, CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, or similar dependency-management tools. Basic understanding of mobile analytics, advertising SDKs, or monetization SDKs. Experience working with Android Studio or Xcode. Learning and Growth You will build strong foundations in: Mobile application and SDK development Android/iOS development API and third-party SDK integration Debugging and performance optimization Software testing and release management Mobile advertising and monetization technologies Role: Mobile / App Developer Industry Type: IT Services & Consulting Department: Engineering - Software & QA Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent Role Category: Software Development Education UG: B.C.A. in Any Specialization, B.Tech / B.E. in Any Specialization Key Skills Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills KotlinJava OOPSData StructuresRest API DevelopmentSwiftObjective CSDK IntegrationsGradle
